match.title: South Africa vs Kenya AFCON 2027 Qualifiers 3D Soccer Pitch Graphics Analysis
match.resultNote: Four goals are shown in the clip, two for each side: South Africa 2–2 Kenya. The footage carries no scoreboard, so the score here is a count of the goals shown.

footage.kind: Highlights reel from one high camera, 1280 × 720, 3 min 13 s, with no on-screen clock or scoreboard
footage.rights: Used with the permission of the rights holder.
footage.method: Events placed by eye from the pitch markings to within about 5 m.

coordinates: x from the left goal line (0-105), y from the near (camera-side) touchline (0-68). t is seconds into the clip; the footage has no match clock. Before the change of ends (up to 2:21 of the clip) South Africa attack toward x = 105 and Kenya toward x = 0; after it the directions swap.

sequences.label: Clip 0:00
sequences.title: Kenya shot saved
notes: One diagonal of about 37 m moved the ball from the centre circle to the near touchline. No. 19 then carried it about 12 m to the edge of the area.
The cross travelled about 30 m to the far side of the penalty spot, and the shot came about 2 seconds after it was struck.
The shot was taken about 12 m from goal with two defenders inside 5 m. The goalkeeper held it.

events.note: Long diagonal from the centre circle to the near touchline.
First-time effort on the far side of the penalty spot, saved low. The shooter's number is not legible.

sequences.label: Clip 0:41
sequences.title: South Africa shot saved
notes: The chance came from the far side: a short carry, then a cross of about 30 m from outside the area.
The ball was met about 11 m from goal, roughly 1 second after the cross was struck.
One defender was within a metre at the shot. The goalkeeper saved low and held the ball, so there was no rebound.

events.note: Met in the area with a defender tight. Saved low and held.

sequences.label: Clip 0:52
sequences.title: South Africa shot off target
notes: A forward pass of about 21 m found the striker at the edge of the area with two defenders inside 5 m.
He carried about 7 m into the area before he was tackled. A team-mate won the loose ball within half a second.
The second effort came from about 11 m in a central position and missed the target. Shot choice with two defenders close is the talking point.

events.note: The start of this pass is off frame during a camera pan. It is placed from the flight of the ball.
Second effort after the tackle. The ball finished behind the goal.

sequences.label: Clip 1:05
sequences.title: South Africa 1–0
notes: The goal started with Kenya in possession: a square pass of about 18 m infield from the far side of their own area.
The next touch went back toward Kenya's goal with a South African forward about 3 to 4 m behind, and the ball ran free for under 2 seconds.
The last touch was about 14 m out, in a challenge. The footage does not show who made it, so no scorer is named.

events.note: Square pass infield from the far side of the area.
Played back toward his own goal with a South African forward closing from behind.

The last touch came in a challenge just inside the area. From this angle it is not clear whether the South African forward or the Kenyan defender touched it last. South African players collect the ball from the net.

sequences.label: Clip 1:24
sequences.title: South Africa shot saved
notes: Built down the near side: a carry of about 10 m, then the ball was worked infield and back out to the same channel.
The final pass put the shooter in the area with about 2 seconds on the ball before the shot.
The shot came from about 16 m from the centre of goal at a tight angle. The save left a rebound, and Kenya's No. 4 reached it first.

events.note: Laid off under a challenge at the edge of the area.
Low shot from the near side of the area, pushed away by the goalkeeper at his near post.

sequences.label: Clip 1:39
sequences.title: South Africa run blocked
notes: A straight run of about 13 m from the edge of the D, between Kenya's No. 3 and No. 4.
The effort came about 8 m out with the goalkeeper already off his line, and it was blocked at the forward's feet.
Both centre-backs were within 5 m as he entered the area and neither made a tackle. Worth reviewing who steps in and who covers.

events.note: Run from the edge of the D between Kenya's No. 3 and No. 4.
The goalkeeper came off his line and blocked at the forward's feet. The ball ran wide of the near post.

sequences.label: Clip 1:46
sequences.title: Kenya penalty 1–1
notes: The free kick was struck on the near side about 42 m from goal and carried about 36 m into the area.
The referee pointed to the spot about 4 seconds after the delivery. The contact that led to the penalty cannot be seen from this camera.
No. 14 put the penalty low to the goalkeeper's right. The goalkeeper went the right way and did not reach it.

events.note: Free kick from the near side into a crowded area. The referee points to the spot about 4 seconds later; the offence is not visible from this angle.
Penalty, low to the goalkeeper's right. Shot quality is the usual fixed figure for a penalty.

sequences.label: Clip 2:13
sequences.title: South Africa shot saved
notes: A carry of about 10 m across the front of the area, then a shot from about 23 m.
Two defenders were inside 5 m at the shot, the nearest about 1.5 m away.
Kenya's No. 23 saved and held the ball. From this range the chance is low quality; no pass option is visible in the frame.

sequences.label: Clip 2:27
sequences.title: South Africa 2–1
notes: South Africa went from about 10 m inside Kenya's half to a shot in about 6 seconds.
The ball was moved to the far side of the area and back to the middle: two passes of about 23 m and 14 m, and the defence had to shift each time.
No. 10 shot from about 13 m with two defenders inside 5 m, one of them sliding in.

events.note: Lifted to the far side of the area.
A team-mate was in front of the goalkeeper as the ball arrived, so a touch on the way through cannot be ruled out from this angle.

sequences.label: Clip 2:53
sequences.title: Kenya 2–2
notes: No. 15 carried the ball about 28 m from near halfway to the edge of the D with a defender alongside him.
Three South African players were inside 5 m when he shot, and none had blocked the shooting lane.
The shot was from about 22 m. By position this is a low-quality chance, so credit the strike and review how the carry was allowed to run.

events.note: Low shot from the top of the D. It ran past team-mate No. 22, who did not touch it, and beat the goalkeeper's dive.
